channel.description: This is a randomly ordered feed of the most recent entries from SSbreakingHeadlines, skipping any feeds with errors.

item.title: Iran Highlights Trade Relations as U.S. Shifts from Military to Economic Pressure
item.description: With VP Vance calling economic pressure 'the most effective tool,' Iran showcases growing trade ties with neighboring countries.

item.title: Trump appears on radio show of Michael Cohen, fixer-turned-foe, after detente
item.description: President Trump made a surprising public appearance on the radio show of Michael Cohen, his former fixer turned critic, marking a reconciliation that seemed unlikely.

item.title: Japan hangs man convicted of killing 5 people at pachinko parlor
item.description: Sunao Takami was executed for setting fire to a crowded pachinko parlor in Osaka, spreading gasoline and igniting it, resulting in five deaths and multiple injuries.

item.title: WATCH: USS Lincoln heading home after 272 days at sea
item.description: President Trump has pledged unprecedented economic warfare against Iran, while the USS Lincoln returns home after a record 272-day deployment.
